character: A mid-sized ski area at the top of Big Cottonwood Canyon, next to Solitude, with a strong local and snowboard following, terrain parks and lift-served night skiing on part of the mountain.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain sits near the base, served by the Explorer lift, and the resort runs a ski and snowboard school. Confirm current learning lifts, carpets and lesson products.

season.notes: Not researched in this build (web-search budget exhausted, page fetches blocked). No 2026-27 opening or closing date is on file as of 2026-09-28 — check the official site. Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-80 E and I-215 S to Exit 6 / 6200 South, Wasatch Blvd to the canyon mouth, then SR-190 up Big Cottonwood Canyon); not a routing-service result. Storm days, traction-law enforcement and avalanche-control closures of SR-190 can add hours.

transfers.name: UTA ski bus (Big Cottonwood Canyon service)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Utah Transit Authority has run winter ski-bus service from Salt Lake Valley park-and-ride lots up SR-190 to Solitude and Brighton. 2026-27 routes, schedule and fares are unconfirmed.

transfers.name: Shared or private airport shuttles from SLC
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: several private operators run airport transfers to the Cottonwood Canyon and Park City resorts. No operator, fare or schedule is on file.

transfers.name: Rental car from SLC
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Utah applies a winter traction law in the Cottonwood canyons (SR-190 Big Cottonwood) that can require 4WD/AWD or suitable snow tires/chains. Parking rules for 2026-27 are unknown.
